models.label: Kokoro v1.0 · English
models.licenseText: Kokoro weights: Apache License 2.0. The bundled downloadable eSpeak NG frontend data is GPL-3.0; its notices are preserved. English voices only are enabled in this release.
models.description: 28 English voices. Includes the required eSpeak NG pronunciation data; no weights are bundled in the APK.

models.label: Supertonic 3 · Russian / English
models.licenseText: Supertonic 3 weights are governed by the BigScience Open RAIL-M License, including its use restrictions. The conversion mirror's MIT label does not replace the original model license. Read the full license before use.
models.description: 10 voice styles, each available in English and Russian. Quantized ONNX models; speech remains on this device.

models.label: Microsoft Edge · Online
models.licenseText: Online speech uses Microsoft's consumer Read Aloud service and is subject to Microsoft service terms. Text is sent to Microsoft when you explicitly choose an online voice and request speech. This unofficial endpoint may change or become unavailable.
models.description: Internet required. No model download. Text leaves the device only when an online voice is selected and speech is requested.

models.label: Shtorm PocketTTS Russian (fast)
models.licenseText: Russian adaptation by ArtShtorm; PocketTTS (c) Kyutai Labs. Reference voice: VCTK p228 from the pinned Kyutai voice collection; CSTR VCTK Corpus, University of Edinburgh, (c) 2019 Junichi Yamagishi; creators C. Veaux, J. Yamagishi, K. MacDonald (CC-BY-4.0). App-converted ONNX graphs and tokenizer bridge; original checkpoint is unchanged. Files and full attribution: https://github.com/SSS135/local-voice-tts/releases/tag/shtorm-model-v1
models.description: Russian v2 fast. Verified ONNX files from the LocalVoice GitHub release. VCTK p228 reference voice; processed on this device.

models.label: Silero v5.6 · Russian
models.licenseText: Silero TTS v5_6_ru (c) Silero Team, https://github.com/snakers4/silero-models, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0: non-commercial use only. App-converted ONNX graph and re-serialised stress/homograph frontend; weights unchanged. Files and full attribution: https://github.com/SSS135/local-voice-tts/releases/tag/silero-ru-model-v1
models.description: Five Russian voices, 48 kHz, with Silero's automatic stress, ё and homograph handling. Verified files from the LocalVoice GitHub release; processed on this device.

models.label: PocketTTS English (Alba)
models.licenseText: PocketTTS by Kyutai Labs, checkpoint english_2026-09_2 (CC-BY-4.0); fixed Alba MacKenna voice (CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/kyutai/tts-voices#alba-mackenna). Modified by the LocalVoice project: ONNX export, INT8 quantization, Alba voice prompt recovered from Kyutai's precomputed voice state. Files and full attribution: https://github.com/SSS135/local-voice-tts/releases/tag/pocket-en-model-v2
models.description: Fixed Alba voice, Kyutai english_2026-09_2 checkpoint (October 2026), INT8 ONNX from the LocalVoice GitHub release. Processed on this device.

models.label: NeuTTS Nano · English (experimental)
models.licenseText: NeuTTS Nano by Neuphonic Ltd (Q4_0 GGUF backbone, reference voices dave, jo, emily, paul, sophie, steven): NeuTTS Open License v1.0, free for research and limited commercial use, paid licence above Neuphonic's revenue threshold. NeuCodec int8 ONNX decoder: Apache-2.0, modified by Local Voice (its 9 fp32 convolutions re-expressed as per-channel int8 matrix multiplies). eSpeak NG English data: GPL-3.0-or-later. Files redistributed unchanged except the reference codes (torch tensors converted to integer text) and the decoder convolutions. Full attribution: https://github.com/SSS135/local-voice-tts/releases/tag/neutts-nano-model-v2
models.description: Six English voices cloned from Neuphonic's reference samples; 229M-parameter speech language model plus NeuCodec, 24 kHz. Heavy: about real time on a Pixel 7 Pro CPU, warms the phone. Processed on this device.
